title: Living Wiki + Graph: make the freshness signal reachable by agents

AC1.note: wiki-freshness-op.test.ts registry tests; keryx commands --json shows wiki freshness/refresh/verify/migrate-markers with read, json and sideEffects

AC2.note: Asserted per command: freshness read:true, the other three read:false with a non-empty sideEffects list — a registered write with no declared effect would be a claim an agent acts on

AC3.note: The operation returns the report including limitations, and the formatter prints them FIRST; test asserts the INCOMPLETE block appears before the finding list

AC4.note: wiki-freshness-op.test.ts 'with no report it says so instead of returning a clean-looking empty result' — output contains NO-REPORT and the not-evidence sentence, and no findings section

AC5.note: wiki-freshness-op.test.ts compares the full project tree and the report file byte-for-byte before and after the call; operation declared risk: read

AC6.note: skills/gdwiki/SKILL.md route added, covering all four categories and the limitations-first rule, plus that stamping provenance is a human act

AC7.note: see the full-suite result recorded in the journal

tasks.dispositionReason: Self-review: the registry coverage guard rejected read:true on a command that writes its own report. read feeds isAutoAllowable, so true would let an agent invoke it unapproved. Corrected to read:false with the reasoning recorded at the site; the MCP surface is the genuinely read-only path
